policy.rule: Scanner evidence may support a control but never changes the control to validated/✅ by itself.

notes.1: Supports detection of secret patterns in scanned source/files.
notes.2: Git mode can support secret detection in repository history.
notes.3: Can support artifact/archive secret scanning when the scanner invocation actually covers the artifact.
notes.4: A finding can identify exposure; rotation/revocation still requires separate evidence.
notes.70: Can contribute evidence about source/artifact integrity hygiene but does not validate CI/CD integrity alone.

notes.54: Supports known-vulnerability findings for detected dependencies/packages.
notes.55: Supports supply-chain evidence, but does not alone validate origin, maintenance or lockfile policy.
notes.70: Can contribute dependency/SBOM/artifact evidence; it does not validate the complete CI/CD integrity control.
